Maya Patel: Quick accessibility nit from today's console pass — the "Skip to content" link is visually hidden but doesn't announce on VoiceOver when focused. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal/short/snip123 :eyes:
Kevin Zhou: Can repro on Chrome+NVDA. When header becomes sticky the focus outline seems to get clipped. Possibly z-index/overflow issue.
Anya Romanov: We should add an offscreen visible focus state when skip link receives focus. Also ensure role=main on the primary content container so SR lands properly.
Kevin Zhou: Example CSS I used to fix locally:
```css
.skip-link{position:absolute;left:-999px;}
.skip-link:focus{left:16px;top:16px;z-index:9999;background:#ffffff;color:#111;padding:8px;border-radius:4px;outline:3px solid #ffbf47;}
```
Note contrast for that outline is probably too low against white. :thinking_face:
Sasha Lee: Outline color needs to hit 4.5:1 for small text — aim for high contrast. Suggest using #005fcc on white or a dark fill with a lighter outline. Also add an aria-live='polite' announcer that updates when skip is used: e.g. "Skipped to main content" so VoiceOver/NVDA get a clear cue.
a11y-bot: Quick auto-check: skip-link focusable ✅; role=main missing on #content ❌; .focus-outline color-contrast ratio 3.2:1 ⚠️ — see report: https://redwood-internal/a11y/reports/1953218888
Maya Patel: Thanks — will patch role=main and try Sasha's color. One more: keyboard order when the left drawer is open — tabbing lands in drawer then header skip link before main. We want skip to skip the header and land in main even with drawer overlay.
Kevin Zhou: We should trap focus in drawer when open and restore focus back to trigger on close. For skip behavior, ensure skip link target is the first focusable in main (e.g., h1 with tabindex='-1'). Also check sticky header z-index; I suspect overflow hidden on .app-shell is clipping the outline.
Anya Romanov: Agree. Add tabindex='-1' to the H1 and use aria-labelledby where appropriate for complex panels. We'll add a small Playwright keyboard E2E that mimics tab/shift-tab and asserts where focus lands, and a manual NVDA + VoiceOver checklist for QA.
Maya Patel: Patch incoming — PR later today. Tagging @eng-runtime for potential z-index hazard with sticky containers. :white_check_mark:
Sasha Lee: Quick reminder — when you update focus styles, please run the color contrast check and include a screenshot of the focus ring on both default and high-contrast themes.
Maya Patel: Will do. Thanks everyone!
